tap.about: A solid, cushioned fingertip contact with a low, warm body; the default cursor tap.

click.about: A firm, solid press with a short settle after it; a little firmer and longer than tap.

tick.about: A muted key contact; three equally calibrated timbres for fast typing.

toggle.about: Two restrained latch contacts, 38 ms apart, with a slight change in weight.

pop.about: A soft, rounded arrival with a light, felt attack; no hollow ring, droplet or blip.

swish.about: A short, quiet swell of air for camera/container travel >25% of the frame; never a UI change.

whoosh.about: Quiet, rounded air for camera/container travel >25% of the frame; never a UI change.

sparkle.about: A quiet glint of damped glass that rings out, without air under it, high bells or a glitter trail.

chime.about: A restrained warm-glass confirmation, two low notes with a brief soft tail.

ping.about: One centred, damped-glass notification that rings out; no stereo beating or shimmer.

riser.about: A soft breath that opens into a reveal and crests on the cue, then eases off; no climbing synth.

hit.about: A low, cushioned settle for a landing; audible body without a long sub drop.
